sources.snippet: hima-tts-nano-te-ONNX hima-tts-nano-te (Telugu text to speech, 62M parameters) converted to ONNX, for fast speech on any CPU (Windows, Linux, Mac), with no PyTorch. Same voices, same sound; int8 is smaller and faster, and read just as clearly in our checks.

sources.title: Prahaladha/hima-tts-nano-te · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Telugu text to speech. A small model (62M parameters) that runs on a laptop, no GPU needed. It comes with six voices, and it can also copy a voice from a short recording. pip install speechbrain python -m hima_tts "ఏమండీ, సాయంత్రం free గా ఉన్నారా ...
